checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals paid-optimization, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'paid-optimization' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: Performance is read against the strategy-artifact success_metric, restated verbatim, never a metric invented after the fact.
checks.rule: Body restates the success_metric from the strategy-artifact, instructs stop-and-ask when absent, and forbids inventing a metric to optimize toward after the fact.

checks.description: Every scale, cut, and rotation move is a proposal for the human gate; the skill never acts on the live campaign.
checks.rule: Body marks every move as a proposal with the human gate as decision owner and states the skill never pauses, shifts budget, or rotates creative on the live campaign.

checks.description: The plan covers scale, cut, and creative-rotation moves, each with evidence and expected effect.
checks.rule: Body defines scale, cut, and creative-rotation moves, each with evidence (number, source, window) and an expected effect tied to the success_metric.

checks.description: No move proposes spend beyond the brief budget or window.
checks.rule: Body states spend beyond the brief budget is never proposed and moves stay within the brief budget and window.

checks.description: Creative rotation references QA-passed variants by id and requests new variants from streams 3 and 4; copy is not written here.
checks.rule: Body references QA-passed variants by id for rotation and requests new creative or copy from streams 3 and 4 rather than writing it.

checks.description: Vanity metrics are excluded as a result bar against the success_metric.
checks.rule: Body excludes vanity metrics (impressions, raw reach) as a result bar.

checks.description: No invented success_metric, target, offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name; no accreditation or roadmap leaks.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing metrics, targets, offers, prices, Skill Path titles, and instructor names, and bars accreditation claims and unannounced plans.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
